name: Tintin and the Lake of Sharks

paragraphs.text: Tintin and the Lake of Sharks () is a 1972 French-Belgian animated adventure film based on The Adventures of Tintin, directed by Raymond Leblanc. It was not written by Hergé (who merely supervised), but by his friend, Belgian comics creator Greg (Michel Regnier). It was later adapted into a comic book with still images from the film used as illustrations.
